ixbrowser.profileRunNotes: Use only selected normal Facebook/IXBrowser profiles for the run. Default production concurrency is 4 normal accounts at a time. Never use shopyourlikes, moderator, or wise profiles for posting/commenting. Close every normal IXBrowser profile after its post/comment work finishes; keep only the dedicated ShopYourLikes profile open.
ixbrowser.notes: Each IXBrowser profile should map to one proxy and one Facebook account.

memory.notes: Keep Hermes prompts compact. Summarize large banks and cap job runtime/output so context windows stay usable.

triggers.notes: Triggers define when the local worker is allowed to run. External actions still require the arm switch.

security.notes: Dashboard is local-only. Machine-level ports are audited but not closed automatically to avoid locking out remote administration.
